name: Philip V, King of Macedon
bio: Philip V was king of Macedon from 221 BC until his death in 179 BC. The Greek Anthology preserves under his name a mocking couplet written in answer to an epigram of Alcaeus of Messene.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the fifth volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Loeb, 1918): Book XVI: 26b.

poems.title: Book XVI, 26b
poems.author: Philip V, King of Macedon
poems.text: Barren and leafless, traveller, on this ridge a lofty cross is planted by Alcaeus.
